title: Chess Player Tries Xianqi (Chinese Chess)
summary: The creator, a chess player, learns and plays Xiangqi (Chinese chess) online against human opponents.
rules: Standard Xiangqi on a 9x10 grid; pieces sit on intersections; a river divides the board and each side has a 3x3 palace.
General: one step orthogonally, confined to palace; the two generals may not face each other on an open file.
Advisors: one step diagonally within palace. Elephants: exactly two diagonal steps, cannot cross the river, blocked if the midpoint is occupied.
Horse: one orthogonal then one diagonal step outward; blocked if the orthogonal square is occupied.
Chariot: like a rook. Cannon: moves like a rook but captures only by jumping exactly one piece (screen).
Soldier: one step forward; after crossing the river may also step sideways; never backward; no promotion.
Stalemate is a loss for the stalemated side; perpetual check is forbidden (standard Xiangqi).
win_condition: Checkmate or stalemate the enemy general.

board.shape_notes: Xiangqi grid: 9 files x 10 ranks of intersections, river in the middle, palaces marked with diagonals
board.theme_notes: cream paper-style board with drawn grid lines; purple dots for legal moves; clocks
